/* Shared JSON contract with desktop/color_engine.py. No eval or Function. */
(function(root) {
'use strict';
const CHANNELS={HSL:['H','S','L'],RGB:['R','G','B'],CMYK:['C','M','Y','K']};
const LIMITS={H:360,S:100,L:100,R:255,G:255,B:255,C:100,M:100,Y:100,K:100};
const clamp=(v,lo=0,hi=100)=>Math.min(hi,Math.max(lo,v));
const wrap=v=>((v%360)+360)%360;
const clone=v=>JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(v));
const uid=()=>globalThis.crypto?.randomUUID?.().replace(/-/g,'').slice(0,12)||Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,14);
function hslRgb([h,s,l]) {h=wrap(h)/360;s=clamp(s)/100;l=clamp(l)/100;const c=(1-Math.abs(2*l-1))*s;const x=c*(1-Math.abs(h*6%2-1));const m=l-c/2;const rgb=h<1/6?[c,x,0]:h<2/6?[x,c,0]:h<3/6?[0,c,x]:h<4/6?[0,x,c]:h<5/6?[x,0,c]:[c,0,x];return rgb.map(v=>(v+m)*255);}
function rgbHsl(rgb,fallback=0) {const [r,g,b]=rgb.map(v=>clamp(v,0,255)/255),max=Math.max(r,g,b),min=Math.min(r,g,b),d=max-min,l=(max+min)/2;let h=fallback,s=0;if(d>1e-10){s=d/(1-Math.abs(2*l-1));h=(max===r?(g-b)/d+(g<b?6:0):max===g?(b-r)/d+2:(r-g)/d+4)*60;}return[wrap(h),s*100,l*100];}
function hexHsl(hex){hex=hex.trim().replace(/^#/,'');if(hex.length===3)hex=[...hex].map(x=>x+x).join('');if(!/^[a-f\d]{6}$/i.test(hex))throw Error('Enter a six-digit HEX color, such as #C92235.');return rgbHsl([0,2,4].map(i=>parseInt(hex.slice(i,i+2),16)));}
const toHex=hsl=>'#'+hslRgb(hsl).map(v=>Math.round(clamp(v,0,255)).toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('').toUpperCase();
function values(hsl){const rgb=hslRgb(hsl),k=1-Math.max(...rgb)/255,cmy=k>.999999999?[0,0,0]:rgb.map(v=>(1-v/255-k)/(1-k)*100);return Object.fromEntries([...'HSLRGBCMYK'].map((ch,i)=>[ch,[...hsl,...rgb,...cmy,k*100][i]]));}
function fromModel(model,out,fallback=0){if(model==='HSL')return[wrap(out.H),clamp(out.S),clamp(out.L)];if(model==='RGB')return rgbHsl([..."RGB"].map(c=>out[c]),fallback);return rgbHsl([..."CMY"].map(c=>255*(1-clamp(out[c])/100)*(1-clamp(out.K)/100)),fallback);}
const funcs={min:Math.min,max:Math.max,abs:Math.abs,round:Math.round,sqrt:Math.sqrt,sin:Math.sin,cos:Math.cos,clamp,wrap};
function evaluate(expression,variables){
 if(typeof expression!=='string'||!expression.length||expression.length>500)throw Error('A formula must contain 1–500 characters.');
 const tokens=[];let p=0;while(p<expression.length){const tail=expression.slice(p);let m;if(/^\s/.test(tail)){p++;continue;}if(m=tail.match(/^(?:\d+(?:\.\d*)?|\.\d+)(?:[eE][+-]?\d+)?/)){tokens.push({type:'number',value:Number(m[0])});p+=m[0].length;}else if(m=tail.match(/^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z_0-9]*/)){tokens.push({type:'name',value:m[0]});p+=m[0].length;}else if(tail.startsWith('**')){tokens.push({type:'^'});p+=2;}else if('+-*/^(),'.includes(tail[0])){tokens.push({type:tail[0]});p++;}else throw Error('Unsupported character in formula.');}
 if(tokens.length>150)throw Error('Formula is too complex.');let i=0;
 const at=t=>tokens[i]?.type===t,take=t=>{if(!at(t))throw Error('Invalid formula syntax.');return tokens[i++];};
 const check=v=>{if(!Number.isFinite(v)||Math.abs(v)>1e12)throw Error('Formula result must be finite and within ±1 trillion.');return v;};
 function atom(){if(at('number'))return check(take('number').value);if(at('(')){take('(');const v=sum();take(')');return v;}if(at('name')){const name=take('name').value;if(at('(')){if(!Object.hasOwn(funcs,name))throw Error('Unknown function: '+name);take('(');let args=[];if(!at(')')){args.push(sum());while(at(',')){take(',');args.push(sum());}}take(')');const [lo,hi]=['min','max'].includes(name)?[2,8]:name==='clamp'?[3,3]:[1,1];if(args.length<lo||args.length>hi)throw Error('Wrong number of function arguments.');return check(funcs[name](...args));}if(!Object.hasOwn(variables,name))throw Error('Unknown variable: '+name);return check(variables[name]);}throw Error('Invalid formula syntax.');}
 function power(){let a=atom();if(at('^')){take('^');const b=unary();if(Math.abs(b)>20||Math.abs(a)>1e6)throw Error('Power is too large.');a=check(a**b);}return a;}
 function unary(){if(at('+')){take('+');return unary();}if(at('-')){take('-');return -unary();}return power();}
 function product(){let v=unary();while(at('*')||at('/')){const op=tokens[i++].type,r=unary();v=check(op==='*'?v*r:v/r);}return v;}
 function sum(){let v=product();while(at('+')||at('-')){const op=tokens[i++].type,r=product();v=check(op==='+'?v+r:v-r);}return v;}
 const result=sum();if(i!==tokens.length)throw Error('Unexpected content after formula.');return check(result);
}
function resolve(ball,strength=ball.strength){const result={base:[...ball.base]},roles=new Map(ball.roles.map(r=>[r.id,r])),visiting=new Set();function get(id){if(Object.hasOwn(result,id))return result[id];if(visiting.has(id))throw Error('Color links form a cycle. Choose a different source.');if(!roles.has(id))throw Error('Missing source color: '+id);visiting.add(id);const role=roles.get(id),source=get(role.source),vars={...values(source),t:strength,pi:Math.PI},out=Object.fromEntries(CHANNELS[role.model].map(c=>[c,Math.round(evaluate(role.expressions[c],vars))]));result[id]=fromModel(role.model,out,source[0]);visiting.delete(id);return result[id];}for(const id of roles.keys())get(id);return result;}
function defaultBall(name='Carmine study',base=[354,75,45]){const role=(id,name,h,s,l)=>({id,name,source:'base',model:'HSL',expressions:{H:`H + (${h}) * t`,S:`S + (${s}) * t`,L:`L + (${l}) * t`}});return{id:uid(),name,baseName:'Base',base:[...base],mode:'cel',softness:0,strength:1,roles:[role('highlight','Highlight',15,5,8),role('shadow','Shadow',-8,-10,-10),role('rim','Shadow rim',-30,-8,-7),role('bounce','Bounce light',-65,-20,7)]};}
const defaultProject=()=>({schema:'shadelab.project',version:1,name:'Untitled studies',balls:[defaultBall(),defaultBall('Midnight study',[211,48,18])],comparisons:[.5,1,2,3]});
const roleName=(ball,id)=>id==='base'?(ball.baseName||'Base'):ball.roles.find(r=>r.id===id)?.name||id;
function lockOffsets(ball){const colors=resolve(ball),base=ball.base;for(const role of ball.roles){const color=colors[role.id],d=[wrap(color[0]-base[0]+180)-180,color[1]-base[1],color[2]-base[2]];Object.assign(role,{source:'base',model:'HSL',expressions:Object.fromEntries([...'HSL'].map((c,i)=>[c,`${c} + (${Number(d[i].toPrecision(8))}) * t`]))});}ball.strength=1;}
function editColor(ball,id,hsl,group=false){const colors=resolve(ball);if(group){const old=colors[id],all=Object.values(colors),ds=clamp(hsl[1]-old[1],-Math.min(...all.map(c=>c[1])),100-Math.max(...all.map(c=>c[1]))),dl=clamp(hsl[2]-old[2],-Math.min(...all.map(c=>c[2])),100-Math.max(...all.map(c=>c[2])));ball.base=[wrap(ball.base[0]+hsl[0]-old[0]),ball.base[1]+ds,ball.base[2]+dl];}else if(id==='base')ball.base=[wrap(hsl[0]),clamp(hsl[1]),clamp(hsl[2])];else{const role=ball.roles.find(r=>r.id===id),current=values(colors[id]),target=values(hsl);for(const c of CHANNELS[role.model]){let d=target[c]-current[c];if(c==='H')d=wrap(d+180)-180;if(Math.abs(d)>1e-7){let expr=role.expressions[c],m=expr.match(/^\((.*)\) \+ \(([-+\d.eE]+)\)$/);if(m){expr=m[1];d+=Number(m[2]);}role.expressions[c]=Math.abs(d)<1e-8?expr:`(${expr}) + (${Number(d.toPrecision(8))})`;}}resolve(ball);}}
function simpleAmounts(role){for(const kind of ['points','percent']){const amounts={};for(const c of CHANNELS[role.model]){const pattern=kind==='points'?`^${c} \\+ \\(([-+\\d.eE]+)\\) \\* t$`:`^${c} \\* \\(1 \\+ \\(([-+\\d.eE]+)\\) / 100 \\* t\\)$`;const m=role.expressions[c].match(new RegExp(pattern));if(!m)break;amounts[c]=Number(m[1]);}if(Object.keys(amounts).length===CHANNELS[role.model].length)return{kind,amounts};}return{kind:null,amounts:Object.fromEntries(CHANNELS[role.model].map(c=>[c,0]))};}
function fitLine(points){if(points.length<2)return null;const n=points.length,sx=points.reduce((a,p)=>a+p[0],0)/n,sy=points.reduce((a,p)=>a+p[1],0)/n,v=points.reduce((a,p)=>a+(p[0]-sx)**2,0);if(v<1e-12)return{vertical:sx};const m=points.reduce((a,p)=>a+(p[0]-sx)*(p[1]-sy),0)/v,b=sy-m*sx,ss=points.reduce((a,p)=>a+(p[1]-sy)**2,0),error=points.reduce((a,p)=>a+(p[1]-(m*p[0]+b))**2,0);return{m,b,r2:ss>1e-12?1-error/ss:1};}
const preset=(ball,name)=>({schema:'shadelab.formula',version:1,name,baseName:ball.baseName||'Base',roles:clone(ball.roles),mode:ball.mode,softness:ball.softness});
function applyPreset(ball,data){const trial=clone(ball);for(const k of ['baseName','roles','mode','softness'])if(Object.hasOwn(data,k))trial[k]=clone(data[k]);trial.strength=1;validateBall(trial);Object.assign(ball,trial);}
function validateBall(b){if(!b||typeof b!=='object'||typeof b.name!=='string'||typeof b.id!=='string')throw Error('Every ball needs an id and name.');if(Object.hasOwn(b,'baseName')&&typeof b.baseName!=='string')throw Error('Base color name must be text.');if(Object.hasOwn(b,'groupMove')&&typeof b.groupMove!=='boolean')throw Error('groupMove must be true or false.');if(!Array.isArray(b.base)||b.base.length!==3||b.base.some((v,i)=>!Number.isFinite(v)||v<0||v>[360,100,100][i]))throw Error('Base HSL is out of range.');if(!['cel','rim'].includes(b.mode))throw Error('Unknown sphere mode.');for(const [key,max] of [['strength',10],['softness',100]])if(!Number.isFinite(b[key])||b[key]<0||b[key]>max)throw Error('Invalid '+key);if(!Array.isArray(b.roles))throw Error('Roles must be a list.');const ids=new Set(['base']);for(const r of b.roles){if(!r||typeof r.id!=='string'||!/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,80}$/.test(r.id)||ids.has(r.id)||['__proto__','constructor','prototype'].includes(r.id))throw Error('Role IDs must be unique and cannot be reserved.');ids.add(r.id);if(typeof r.name!=='string'||typeof r.source!=='string'||!Object.hasOwn(CHANNELS,r.model)||!r.expressions||CHANNELS[r.model].some(c=>!Object.hasOwn(r.expressions,c)))throw Error('Invalid color role.');}resolve(b);}
function validateDocument(data){if(!data||data.version!==1)throw Error('Expected Shade Lab JSON version 1.');if(Object.hasOwn(data,'name')&&typeof data.name!=='string')throw Error('Document name must be text.');if(data.schema==='shadelab.project'){if(!Array.isArray(data.balls)||!data.balls.length)throw Error('Project must contain at least one ball.');const ids=new Set();for(const b of data.balls){validateBall(b);if(ids.has(b.id))throw Error('Ball IDs must be unique.');ids.add(b.id);}const ts=Object.hasOwn(data,'comparisons')?data.comparisons:[.5,1,2,3];if(!Array.isArray(ts)||!ts.length||ts.some(t=>!Number.isFinite(t)||t<0||t>10))throw Error('Comparison strengths must be between 0 and 10.');const samples=Object.hasOwn(data,'samples')?data.samples:[];if(!Array.isArray(samples)||samples.some(s=>!Array.isArray(s)||s.length!==3||s.some((v,i)=>!Number.isFinite(v)||v<0||v>[360,100,100][i])))throw Error('Samples must be HSL color arrays.');}else if(data.schema==='shadelab.formula')applyPreset(defaultBall(),data);else throw Error('This is not a Shade Lab project or formula file.');return data;}
function trianglePoint([h,s,l],left=99,top=62,width=149,height=196){return[left+width*(1-Math.abs(2*l/100-1))*s/100,top+height*(1-l/100)];}
function triangleColor(x,y,h,left=99,top=62,width=149,height=196){const l=clamp((1-(y-top)/height)*100),max=1-Math.abs(2*l/100-1),s=max>1e-8?clamp((x-left)/width/max*100):0;return[wrap(h),s,l];}
const api={CHANNELS,LIMITS,clamp,wrap,clone,uid,hslRgb,rgbHsl,hexHsl,toHex,values,fromModel,evaluate,resolve,defaultBall,defaultProject,roleName,lockOffsets,editColor,fitLine,preset,applyPreset,validateBall,validateDocument,trianglePoint,triangleColor,simpleAmounts};
if(typeof module!=='undefined')module.exports=api;root.Shade=api;
})(globalThis);
